methods.title: Five x2 paired runner accepting and refusal smokes
The x1 commit wrapper reached its output window and returned no commit text.
The first x2 builder stopped after the binary-matroid-minors merged runner sent legitimate x1 operations only to the x2 dispatcher.
The first dispatcher patch used one mismatched generated-model context line and failed verification before changing bytes.
The first combined TXT syntax projection reached its short output window and returned no attributable lines.
The first hidden Start-Process localhost-server launch was rejected by the command safety policy before process creation.
The first keyboard browser check targeted an unfocusable body locator and Playwright refused the key action after earlier model and button checks had passed.
The first post-reset diff projection omitted the unchanged status row and falsely reported the reset check as failed.
The first combined x2 staged-review wrapper reached its output window and returned no attributable review row.
